in_arabic.name: معاذ
in_arabic.meaning: محفوظ، حفاظت شدہ، اللہ کی حفاظت میں
in_arabic.long_meaning: معاذ نام کا مطلب ہے محفوظ یا حفاظت شدہ۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا تعلق اللہ کی حفاظت اور محفوظ کرنے سے ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں بھی اس نام کا ذکر ہے، خاص طور پر معاذ بن جبل کے حوالے سے جو صحابی رسول تھے۔

in_hindi.name: मुआज़
in_hindi.meaning: सुरक्षित, संरक्षित, अल्लाह की सुरक्षा में
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुआज़ नाम का अर्थ है सुरक्षित या संरक्षित। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है और इसका संबंध अल्लाह की सुरक्षा और संरक्षण से है। मुआज़ बिन जाबिल एक प्रसिद्ध सहाबी थे जिन्होंने इस्लाम के प्रसार में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

in_pashto.name: معاذ
in_pashto.meaning: ژغورل شوی، خوندي، د الله په حفاظت کې
in_pashto.long_meaning: معاذ نوم معنی یې ژغورل شوی یا خوندي دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه راغلی دی او د الله د حفاظت او ژغورنې سره تړاو لري. معاذ بن جبل يو مشهور صحابي رسول و چې په اسلام کې يې مهم رول ادا کړ.

in_english.name: Mu'Aaz
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mu'Aaz is derived from Arabic roots, meaning 'protected' or 'safeguarded'. It signifies being under Allah's protection and care. data.cultural_impact: Mu'Aaz is a name that carries a sense of dignity, respect, and honor. In many Islamic cultures, it is considered a noble name for a child to be given. It is a name that reflects the values of respecting and honoring others, and thus, the child is expected to embody these values in their behavior and actions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mu'Aaz has spiritual significance as it is a name mentioned in the Quran. In Surah Al-An'am (6:49), Allah SWT says, "Mu'Aaz bin Jabal (from among the Bedouin Arabs) said: 'O my people, I have indeed quit that which is rejected ( disbelief, sins and evil deeds, etc.) and I have embraced that which is rightly-guided (Islam). Thus follow me, and Allah will bestow His Mercy upon you.' " This verse emphasizes the importance of leaving behind sinful ways and embracing righteousness, a concept central to Muslim beliefs. The name Mu'Aaz thus serves as a constant reminder of this lesson, and the bearer of this name is encouraged to strive towards being a person of honor and respect, both in the eyes of God and society.
